items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Louie Armstrong -- and 1924 Louie Gennett Armstrong and I recorded for Jeannette label.

ctx.x: Cine Lido has been there -- but it's still the same building. And I was just wondering what -- what was that like? What was Connie then like?
Connie's Inn was wonderful. Louie Armstrong was playing there, you know.
